_comment: Higher-resolution candidate T1: a targeted layout, generated beside the 16-region baseline. Design and analysis only; nothing here is fabricated, fitted or measured. Each region names the baseline regions it is derived from, so a person's sensor choices carry over (a region whose sources are switched off is left out).
name: T1
description: Targeted subdivisions: heel 2 x 2 (front-back and inner-outer), the three midfoot regions as in the baseline, a row behind the metatarsal heads (front-back detail in the forefoot), the five metatarsal heads, the big toe split into base and tip, and the four lesser toes.
